title: spec: the Virtual Data Engine wire protocol block (`DataEngineRequestSchema` and its arms) has zero readers — decide ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove; its note says "tracked separately" but nothing tracks it
body:
Filing gate: ② a governing note that says "tracked separately" with no tracker. Measured by the contract review on PR #27007 (#26954; record 6458779713, ③ flag 2). Filed by `domain:spec` seat 3 · `os-support-ai` · session `session_01WGufzgbJhFoXYsLSe5WSPP`. ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets the lane and the grade (spec lane suggested).

**Business reason.** `packages/spec/src/data/data-engine.zod.ts` publishes a whole "Virtual ObjectQL" wire protocol: `DataEngineRequestSchema`, `DataEngineFindRequestSchema`, `DataEngineFindOneRequestSchema`, `DataEngineContractSchema` and the rest of the block. Its own note (#4618) says every arm has zero readers in this repo and there is no Virtual Data Engine implementation. A generated client or an AI author reading the published surface sees a protocol nothing serves. The note says the enforce-or-remove question "is tracked separately", but no open card tracks it. Card #26954, the last one that touched the block, closes with PR #27007 and aligned four members without deciding the question; the seat's ruling there was align, not retire.

## Measured

- The note on `DataEngineRequestSchema` (~:1550-1557 on PR #27007's head): "every arm below now has zero readers in this repo … an ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove candidate, deliberately left standing here because retiring a published wire protocol is a different decision from retiring `batch?`, and it is tracked separately".
- The review re-measured on `origin/main` `acc9c57d0a`: no code outside `packages/spec` parses `DataEngineRequestSchema`, `DataEngineFindRequestSchema`, `DataEngineFindOneRequestSchema` or `DataEngineContractSchema`. The hits are the generated reference page's import line, the export ledgers and CHANGELOG prose. The only runtime reader in the file's neighbourhood reads `EngineQueryOptionsSchema` `.shape` keys (`runtime/src/action-execution.ts` ~:2047), which is outside the block.

## Wanted (for triage to grade and route)

Decide ADR-0049 for the block. One option is to enforce it, which means naming a reader that parses it. The other is to retire it from the published surface through the published-surface removal process. Retiring is a major change, so it may need the maintainer's ruling. Either way, rewrite the note so it names this card instead of "tracked separately".

## Dedupe

`search_issues` on this repo, "Virtual Data Engine DataEngineRequestSchema enforce or remove ADR-0049 retire published wire protocol", returned #26954 (the source; it aligns four members and does not decide the block), #4618 (the `batch?` retirement, closed, which left this standing) and #25159 (a different surface, closed). **New.**
